title: OTel SRE-Copilot
tagline: An LLM agent that investigates Kubernetes incidents from OpenTelemetry metrics, traces and logs, and proves every piece of evidence it cites.
problem: During an incident an on-call engineer has to correlate dashboards, traces, logs and Kubernetes events across a dozen services before finding the one that broke. LLM agents promise to automate this, but they are rarely measured against simple anomaly-detection baselines and they can invent evidence.
approach: A LangGraph tool-calling agent queries Prometheus, Tempo, Loki and Kubernetes events through one DataSource interface, under a token budget, and returns ranked root causes with cited evidence. An external verifier checks each citation against the tool calls really made. Faults are injected with Chaos Mesh on the OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop, recorded as replayable snapshots, and scored against random and z-score baselines.

demo.caption: Replay of a recorded agent run on the checkout pod-crash incident: each Prometheus/Tempo/Loki/Kubernetes tool call, the ranked root causes, the cited evidence with the grounding verifier's verdict, and the Chaos Mesh ground truth.

limits: 14 snapshots of 7 single-fault scenarios on one demo app: too small to generalise, and seeds only change the capture time.
Snapshots are replayed, so the agent cannot run queries outside the captured set (unknown PromQL falls back to the closest recorded series).
LLM runs are not bit-reproducible even at temperature 0; variance is reported over 3 runs per snapshot.
Single model measured (NIM free tier); no multi-fault or cascading incidents.
